name: Eko Kristianto
bio: Eko Kristianto is an Indonesian film producer and director. Eko is one of the showrunners for the TV series The East, which airs in NET.

credits.title: Hajatan Setan
credits.overview: A young woman returns to her hometown after being away for years. However, her homecoming reopens old wounds and triggers a series of strange events that slowly engulf the villagers in suspicion and fear.

credits.title: Unseen Sonata
credits.overview: A woman with the gift of foresight tries to prevent her fiance from meeting another woman whom he is truly meant to be with.

credits.title: Princess, Bajak Laut & Alien
credits.overview: The first Indonesian child omnibus film who raise four stories about friendship, family, and courage.

credits.title: Adriana
credits.overview: A playboy's encounter with a woman in the National Library's elevator gets complicated. His invitation to the next meeting was accepted with the riddle she gave him. The answer to the riddle is the time and place of their next meeting.

credits.title: Rectoverso
credits.overview: A love-themed anthology adapted from the music album of the same title by Dewi "Dee" Lestari.

credits.title: Rumah di Seribu Ombak
credits.overview: Little Samihi becomes close friends with a local Balinese child named Wayan Manik who is called Yanik.

credits.title: Jelangkung 3
credits.overview: After daring to sit in a cursed theater seat during a screening of the horror film Jelangkung, Yodi begins to experience terrifying supernatural events. With no one believing him, he must confront his fears — and the spirits — by playing the very game that unleashed them.
